job.job_description:
Job Title: Python Backend Engineer LLM, Agentic AI & MCP

Experience Range
3+ Years

Work Location
Pan India / Remote, India

Employment Type
Contract

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop robust MCP servers for diverse data sources
Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.1 for AI agents
Build and extend AI capabilities through custom MCP tools and prompt templates
Ensure performance, scalability, and security of backend systems and data flows
Integrate MCP servers with AI frameworks and proprietary agent systems
Develop and maintain REST APIs and microservices architectures
Collaborate with cross functional teams and contribute to end to end development

Required Skills

Strong proficiency in Python
Solid experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
Hands on experience with REST APIs and JSON RPC
Understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation
Experience building scalable and secure backend microservices
Proficiency with Git, testing, and debugging practices
Strong problem solving and communication skills
Ability to work independently and adapt to new AI technologies

Optional Skills

Exposure to AI frameworks and agent-based architectures
Experience designing prompt engineering solutions
Familiarity with cloud environments and deployment practices
